scope: all 6387 archived training OOF records; no length, Cys, charge, hydropathy or annotation prefilter
A: sequence correct AND structure wrong AND fusion wrong
B: sequence wrong AND structure wrong AND fusion wrong; separate original-positive FN from original-negative FP
C: at least one branch wrong AND fusion correct
D: at least one branch correct AND fusion wrong; A is subset of D
exclusive_groups: all 8 binary combinations of sequence/structure/fusion correctness, including zero-count cells
matching: within each contrast: same original label and fold, different group; abs length <=3, charge <=2, hydropathy <=0.5, Cys <=1; smallest eligible pool first then normalized squared distance then sample_id; no group reused within contrast. These calipers restrict secondary matched comparisons only, not full-sample grouping.
inference: paired mean difference case minus control; 2000 paired bootstrap; 5000 random sign flips; BH over all 36 tests (3 contrasts x 2 partitions x 6 features); fewer than 5 pairs flagged insufficient
limitations: existing OOF calibration and checkpoint selection are not strictly nested
all folds already inspected; split consistency is descriptive, not independent validation
composition matching does not match assay endpoints or molecular states
error-based grouping supports diagnosis, not causal claims
prior composition screen counts already observed; this is an explicitly redirected exploratory analysis
